@NumStability.leveque01_coordinateSplittingBalance_information : ∀ {D : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq D] {m : ℕ}
  {laws : D → NumStability.OneDimensionalHyperbolicConservationLaw (Fin m)}
  {Result : (d : D) → NumStability.HyperbolicRiemannProblem (laws d) → Type u_2} {Information : D → Type u_3}
  (methods : (d : D) → ℝ → NumStability.RiemannInformationFluxMethod (laws d) (Result d) (Information d))
  (cellVolume : (D → ℤ) → ℝ) (area : D → (D → ℤ) → ℝ) (fallback : D → (D → ℤ) → ℝ → (ℤ → Fin m → ℝ) → Fin m → ℝ)
  (stages : List (D × ℝ)) (state : (D → ℤ) → Fin m → ℝ),
  NumStability.RiemannInformationCoordinate.SweepAdmitted methods cellVolume area fallback stages state →
    (∀ (other : D → (D → ℤ) → ℝ → (ℤ → Fin m → ℝ) → Fin m → ℝ),
        NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.sweep cellVolume
            (NumStability.RiemannInformationCoordinate.guardedRule methods area fallback) stages state =
          NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.sweep cellVolume
            (NumStability.RiemannInformationCoordinate.guardedRule methods area other) stages state) ∧
      ∀ (before : List (D × ℝ)) (d : D) (dt : ℝ) (after : List (D × ℝ)),
        stages = before ++ (d, dt) :: after →
          ∀ (cell : D → ℤ),
            have current :=
              NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.sweep cellVolume
                (NumStability.RiemannInformationCoordinate.guardedRule methods area fallback) before state;
            ∃ (admitted : NumStability.RiemannInformationCoordinate.FaceAdmitted methods d dt current cell),
              let problem :=
                NumStability.adjacentCellRiemannProblem (laws d) (fun j => current (Function.update cell d j)) (cell d);
              have result := (methods d dt).solve problem admitted;
              problem.leftState = current (Function.update cell d (cell d - 1)) ∧
                problem.rightState = current cell ∧
                  NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.normalFaceFlux
                      (NumStability.RiemannInformationCoordinate.guardedRule methods area fallback) d dt current cell =
                    area d cell • (methods d dt).numericalFlux ((methods d dt).extract result)

@NumStability.leveque01_coordinateSplittingBalance_cartesian : ∀ {D : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype D]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq D] {m : ℕ} (axes : D → NumStability.OneDimensionalFiniteVolumeGrid)
  (rule : D → (D → ℤ) → ℝ → (ℤ → Fin m → ℝ) → Fin m → ℝ) (d : D) (dt : ℝ) (state : (D → ℤ) → Fin m → ℝ) (base : D → ℤ),
  (∀ (cell : D → ℤ), 0 < NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes cell) ∧
    (∀ (cell : D → ℤ),
        (volume (NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellBox axes cell)).toReal =
          NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes cell) ∧
      (∀ (cell : D → ℤ),
          (volume (NumStability.CartesianGrid.tangentialFaceBox axes d cell)).toReal =
            NumStability.CartesianGrid.faceArea axes d cell) ∧
        (∀ (cell : D → ℤ), (axes d).cellRight (cell d) = (axes d).cellLeft (Function.update cell d (cell d + 1) d)) ∧
          (fun j =>
              NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.advance (NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes)
                (NumStability.CartesianCoordinateUpdate.areaWeightedRule axes rule) d dt state
                (Function.update base d j)) =
            NumStability.riemannFiniteVolumeUpdate (axes d) dt (fun j => state (Function.update base d j)) fun j =>
              rule d (Function.update base d j) dt fun k => state (Function.update base d k)

@NumStability.NumericsSourceChecks.cartesian_primary_instantiation : ∀ {D : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype D]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq D] {m : ℕ} (axes : D → NumStability.OneDimensionalFiniteVolumeGrid)
  (rule : D → (D → ℤ) → ℝ → (ℤ → Fin m → ℝ) → Fin m → ℝ) (stages : List (D × ℝ)),
  stages ≠ [] →
    (∀ (d : D), ∃ dt, (d, dt) ∈ stages) →
      (∀ stage ∈ stages, 0 < stage.2) →
        ∀ (state : (D → ℤ) → Fin m → ℝ),
          stages ≠ [] ∧
            (∀ (d : D), ∃ dt, (d, dt) ∈ stages) ∧
              (∀ stage ∈ stages, 0 < stage.2) ∧
                ∀ (before : List (D × ℝ)) (d : D) (dt : ℝ) (after : List (D × ℝ)),
                  stages = before ++ (d, dt) :: after →
                    have current :=
                      NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.sweep (NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes)
                        (NumStability.CartesianCoordinateUpdate.areaWeightedRule axes rule) before state;
                    NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.sweep (NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes)
                          (NumStability.CartesianCoordinateUpdate.areaWeightedRule axes rule) stages state =
                        NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.sweep (NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes)
                          (NumStability.CartesianCoordinateUpdate.areaWeightedRule axes rule) after
                          (NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.advance (NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes)
                            (NumStability.CartesianCoordinateUpdate.areaWeightedRule axes rule) d dt current) ∧
                      (∀ (cell : D → ℤ),
                          NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes cell •
                              NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.advance (NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes)
                                (NumStability.CartesianCoordinateUpdate.areaWeightedRule axes rule) d dt current cell =
                            NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes cell • current cell -
                              dt •
                                NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.netOutwardFlux
                                  (NumStability.CartesianCoordinateUpdate.areaWeightedRule axes rule) d dt current
                                  cell) ∧
                        (∀ (base : D → ℤ) (start : ℤ) (count : ℕ),
                            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range count,
                                NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes (Function.update base d (start + ↑k)) •
                                  NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.advance
                                    (NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes)
                                    (NumStability.CartesianCoordinateUpdate.areaWeightedRule axes rule) d dt current
                                    (Function.update base d (start + ↑k)) =
                              ∑ k ∈ Finset.range count,
                                  NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes (Function.update base d (start + ↑k)) •
                                    current (Function.update base d (start + ↑k)) -
                                dt •
                                  (NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.normalFaceFlux
                                      (NumStability.CartesianCoordinateUpdate.areaWeightedRule axes rule) d dt current
                                      (Function.update base d (start + ↑count)) -
                                    NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.normalFaceFlux
                                      (NumStability.CartesianCoordinateUpdate.areaWeightedRule axes rule) d dt current
                                      (Function.update base d start))) ∧
                          ∀ (other : (D → ℤ) → Fin m → ℝ) (base : D → ℤ),
                            (∀ (j : ℤ), current (Function.update base d j) = other (Function.update base d j)) →
                              ∀ (j : ℤ),
                                NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.advance (NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes)
                                    (NumStability.CartesianCoordinateUpdate.areaWeightedRule axes rule) d dt current
                                    (Function.update base d j) =
                                  NumStability.CoordinateLineBalance.advance
                                    (NumStability.CartesianGrid.cellVolume axes)
                                    (NumStability.CartesianCoordinateUpdate.areaWeightedRule axes rule) d dt other
                                    (Function.update base d j)
